title: equisetum ramosissimum var. hispanicum
intro: Equisetum ramosissimum var. hispanicum, commonly known as Spanish scouring rush, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving gut health. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a purgative, laxative, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of constipation, irritable bowel syndrome, and other gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents present in Equisetum ramosissimum var. hispanicum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
